1.consolidated_definition: Producto del cruce del gallo de raza con gallina criolla o viceversa o de dos razas buenas distintas entre sí.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Product of the cross between a rooster of a breed with a native hen or vice versa, or two distinct good breeds between them.
